propositions: Infrastructure exceptions at gates are currently handled asymmetrically: plan/code-review gates catch and degrade to INDETERMINATE, while completion gate propagates uncaught, causing silent failures without passive diagnosis records.
Gate-encountered infra failures must emit an additive ERROR sidecar record with gate_error_v1 schema and error cause/evidence metadata while preserving per-gate outcomes (degrade or fail-close).
ERROR verdict records must not route through reconcile_verdict or be coerced to FAIL, and must be schema-guarded so existing verdict readers skip them and do not surface errors unexpectedly.
Diagnosis intervals must be delimited by gate code (ERROR start on infra exception, PASS end on recovery) rather than agent self-report, eliminating reliability gaps from passive observation.
